decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the established modular portfolio and still has a page of its own in 2024, so keeping it costs little while demand for automated workflows plays out, which keeps its option value above its carrying cost.

The folding add-on unit has a documented customer installation that combines creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass and is still mentioned in 2024, so as a cheap, close add-on that completes the firm's systems it is worth keeping, even though the firm holds many other product options.
